description: Send Telegram messages through the venue's bots — notify a person or group, reply in a chat, or check which bots you can use. Load when a task involves reaching someone on Telegram.

content.inline:
## Telegram
The venue runs one or more Telegram bots. A bot that acts as your identity is yours to send through.

Ops:
- send `{bot?, chatId, text, parseMode?, replyTo?, silent?}` — deliver a message. `chatId` is a numeric Telegram chat id (private chat = the person's user id; groups are negative) or an `@channelusername`. Omit `bot` if you own exactly one.
- bots `{}` — the bots you can use, with state and Telegram username.

Rules:
- Only send to chats you were given by the person or that appear in a message you are answering — never guess chat ids.
- Plain text by default; use `parseMode: "Markdown"` only when formatting matters (unbalanced markup falls back to plain text automatically).
- Keep messages short; long text is split at 4096 characters.
- If a bot is PENDING or missing, say so and stop — you cannot create or configure bots (the venue operator declares them).
